source: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
reference: "Sasa tuna panya wenye umri wa miezi minne ambao hawana kisukari ambao awali walikuwa na kisukari", aliongeza.
hypothesis: "Sasa tuna panya wenye umri wa miezi minne ambao hawana ugonjwa wa kisukari ambao zamani walikuwa na ugonjwa wa kisukari", akaongeza.

source: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
reference: Dak. Ehud Ur, profesa wa udaktari katika chuo kikuu cha Dalhousie kule Halifix, Nova Scotia na mwenyekiti wa kitengo cha kliniki na kisayansi kwenye ushirika wa ugonjwa wa kisukari nchini Canada alionya kuwa utafiti bado uko kwenye siku za mapema.
hypothesis: Dakt. Ehud Ur, profesa wa tiba katika Chuo Kikuu cha Dalhousie huko Halifax, Nova Scotia na mwenyekiti wa idara ya kitiba na kisayansi ya Chama cha Kisukari cha Kanada alionya kwamba utafiti huo bado uko katika siku zake za mwanzo.

source: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
reference: Kama wataalam wengine, ana shaka kuhusu kama ugonjwa wa kisukari unaweza kutibiwa, akagundua kuwa matokeo haya hayana umuhimu kwa watu ambao tayari wana ugojwa wa kisukari wa aina 1.
hypothesis: Kama wataalamu wengine, yeye ni mwenye shaka ikiwa ugonjwa wa kisukari unaweza kutibiwa, akisema kwamba matokeo hayo hayana maana kwa watu ambao tayari wana ugonjwa wa kisukari wa Aina 1.

source: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
reference: Mnamo Jumatatu, Sara Danius, katibu wa kudumu wa Kamati ya Nobel ya Fasihi katika Chuo cha Uswidi, alitangaza hadharani wakati wa kipindi cha redio kwenye Sveriges Radio katika Uswidi kwamba kamati hiyo, kwa kutoweza kumfikia Bob Dylan moja kwa moja kuhusu ushindi wa Tuzo la Nobel la Fasihi 2016, iliacha juhudi zake za kujaribu kumfikia.
hypothesis: Jumatatu, Sara Danius, katibu wa kudumu wa Kamati ya Nobel ya Fasihi katika Chuo cha Uswidi, alitangaza hadharani wakati wa programu ya redio kwenye Sveriges Radio nchini Sweden kamati hiyo, kwa kutokuwa na uwezo wa kumfikia Bob Dylan moja kwa moja kuhusu kushinda Tuzo ya Nobel ya Fasihi ya 2016, ilikuwa imeacha juhudi zake za kumfikia.

source: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
reference: Danius alisema, "Sasa hivi hatufanyi chochote. Nimepiga simu na kutuma barua pepe kwa mshirika wake wa karibu na kupata majibu ya kirafiki sana. Kwa sasa, hakika hiyo imetosha."
hypothesis: Danius alisema, "Kwa sasa hatufanyi chochote. Nimeita na kutuma barua pepe kwa mfanyakazi wake wa karibu na kupokea majibu ya kirafiki sana. Kwa sasa, hiyo ni ya kutosha".

source: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
reference: Hapo awali, Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa Ring, Jamie Siminoff, alitamka kampuni hiyo ilianza wakati kengele yake ya mlangoni haikuwa inasikika katika duka lake kwenye karakana yake.
hypothesis: Mapema, Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa Ring, Jamie Siminoff, alisema kampuni ilianza wakati kengele yake haikuweza kusikika kutoka duka lake katika karakana yake.

source: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
reference: Aliunda kengele ya mlango ya Wi-Fi, alisema.
hypothesis: Alisema alijenga kengele ya mlango wa WiFi.

source: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
reference: Siminoff alisema mauzo yaliongezeka baada ya yeye kuonekana katika kipindi cha Shark Tank mnamo 2013 ambapo paneli ya onyesho hilo ilikataa kufadhili biashara hiyo mpya.
hypothesis: Siminoff alisema mauzo yalizidi baada ya kuonekana kwake katika 2013 katika kipindi cha Shark Tank ambapo jopo la show lilikataa kufadhili kuanza.

source: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
reference: Baadaye 2017, Siminoff alionekana katika chaneli ya ununuzi ya televisheni QVC.
hypothesis: Mwishoni mwa 2017, Siminoff alionekana kwenye kituo cha runinga cha ununuzi QVC.

source: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
reference: Ring pia alitatua mashtaka ya kampuni pinzani ya usalama, Shirika la ADT.
hypothesis: Ring pia alisuluhisha kesi na kampuni ya usalama inayoshindana, ADT Corporation.

source: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
reference: Huku chanjo moja ya majaribio ikionekana kupunguza vifo kutokana na Ebola, hadi kufikia sasa, hakuna dawa zimeonyeshwa dhahiri kufaa kutibu maambukizo yaliyoko.
hypothesis: Ingawa chanjo moja ya majaribio inaonekana kuwa na uwezo wa kupunguza vifo vya Ebola, hadi sasa, hakuna dawa yoyote iliyoonyeshwa wazi kuwa inafaa kutibu maambukizo yaliyopo.

source: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
reference: Kinywaji kimoja cha kingamwili, ZMapp, hapo awali kilionyesha ahadi uwanjani, lakini tafiti rasmi zilionyesha kilikuwa na faida kidogo kuliko ilivyotafutwa katika kuzuia kifo.
hypothesis: Kinywaji kimoja cha kupambana na viini, ZMapp, kilionyesha kwamba kilikuwa na manufaa mengi katika uwanja huo, lakini uchunguzi wa kitaaluma ulionyesha kwamba kilikuwa na manufaa kidogo kuliko ilivyotaka katika kuzuia kifo.

source: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
reference: Katika jaribio la PALM, Zmapp ilitumika kama kidhibiti, kumaanisha wanasayansi waliitumia kama msingi na kulinganisha matibabu mengine matatu nayo.
hypothesis: Katika jaribio la PALM, ZMapp ilitumika kama udhibiti, maana wanasayansi walitumia kama msingi na kulinganisha matibabu mengine matatu nayo.

source: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
reference: USA Gymnastics hukubali barua ya Kamati ya Olimpiki ya Marekani na hukubali hitaji kuu la familia ya Olimpiki la kukuza mazingira salama kwa wanariadha wetu wote.
hypothesis: USA Gymnastics inakubali barua ya Kamati ya Olimpiki ya Marekani na inakubali haja ya kikamilifu ya familia ya Olimpiki ya kukuza mazingira salama kwa wanariadha wetu wote.

source: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
reference: Tunakubaliana na taarifa ya USOC kwamba masilahi ya wanariadha na vilabu vyetu, na spoti yao, huenda yakashughulikiwa vyema kwa kusonga mbele na mabadiliko ya maana ndani ya shirika letu, badala ya kughairi vyeti.
hypothesis: Tunakubaliana na taarifa ya USOC kwamba maslahi ya wanariadha wetu na klabu, na michezo yao, inaweza kutumika vizuri kwa kusonga mbele na mabadiliko ya maana ndani ya shirika letu, badala ya decertification.

source: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
reference: USA Gymnastics inaunga mkono uchunguzi huru ambao labda utafafanua jinsi unyanyasaji wa kiwango kama vile ulivyoelezewa kwa ujasiri sana na manusura wa Larry Nassar ungekosa kugunduliwa kwa muda mrefu hivyo na inakumbatia mabadiliko muhimu na ya kufaa.
hypothesis: USA Gymnastics inasaidia uchunguzi wa kujitegemea ambao unaweza kuangaza mwanga juu ya jinsi unyanyasaji wa kipimo kilichoelezwa kwa ujasiri sana na waliookoka Larry Nassar ungeweza kuwa bila kugunduliwa kwa muda mrefu sana na inachukua mabadiliko yoyote muhimu na sahihi.

source: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
reference: USA Gymnastics na USOC zina lengo moja — kuifanya spoti ya sarakasi, na nyingine, salama iwezekanavyo ili wanariadha wafuate ndoto zao katika mazingira salama, chanya na ya kuwezesha.
hypothesis: USA Gymnastics na USOC wana lengo moja  kufanya michezo ya gymnastics, na wengine, salama iwezekanavyo kwa wanariadha kufuata ndoto zao katika mazingira salama, mazuri na yenye nguvu.

source: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
reference: Katika miaka yote ya 1960, Brzezinski alimfanyia kazi John F. Kennedy kama mshauri wake na pia utawala wa Lyndon B. Johnson.
hypothesis: Katika miaka ya 1960, Brzezinski alifanya kazi kwa John F. Kennedy kama mshauri wake na kisha utawala wa Lyndon B. Johnson.

source: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
reference: Wakati wa uteuzi wa 1976, alimshauri Carter kuhusu sera ya nje, kisha akafanya kazi kama Mshauri wa Usalama wa Kitaifa (NSA) kutoka 1977 hadi 1981, na alichukua hatamu kutoka kwa Henry Kissinger.
hypothesis: Wakati wa uchaguzi wa 1976 aliwashauri Carter juu ya sera za nje, kisha alitumikia kama Mshauri wa Usalama wa Kitaifa (NSA) kutoka 1977 hadi 1981, akifuatia Henry Kissinger.

source: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
reference: Kama NSA, alimsaidia Carter katika kushughulikia masuala ya dunia kidiplomasia, kama vile Mikataba ya Kambi David, 1978; kurekebisha uhusiano wa Marekani na China mwishoni mwa miaka ya 1970; Mapinduzi ya Irani, ambayo yalipelekea janga la mateka la Irani, 1979; na shambulio la Kisovyeti katika Afganistani, 1979.
hypothesis: Kama NSA, alisaidia Carter katika kushughulikia mambo ya kimataifa kidiplomasia, kama vile Makubaliano ya Camp David, 1978; kurekebisha uhusiano wa Marekani na China mwishoni mwa miaka ya 1970; Mapinduzi ya Iran, ambayo yalisababisha mgogoro wa mateka wa Iran, 1979; na uvamizi wa Urusi nchini Afghanistan, 1979.

source: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
reference: Sinema, iliyoshirikisha Ryan Gosling na Emma Stone ilipata uteuzi katika kategoria zote kuu.
hypothesis: Filamu hiyo, iliyo na Ryan Gosling na Emma Stone, ilipokea uteuzi katika makundi yote makubwa.

source: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
reference: Gosling na Stone walipokea uteuzi wa Muigizaji na Mwigizaji wa kike Bora mtawalia.
hypothesis: Gosling na Stone walipokea uteuzi kwa Mchezaji Bora na Mchezaji Bora.

source: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
reference: Uteuzi mwingine unahusisha Picha, Mwelekezi, Sinema, Muundo wa Mavazi, Uhariri wa Filamu, Alama ya Asili, Muundo wa Uzalishaji, Uhariri wa Sauti, Uchanganyaji wa Sauti na Mchezo Halisi wa Skrini Bora.
hypothesis: Maagizo mengine ni pamoja na Picha bora, Mkurugenzi, Sinema, Ubunifu wa mavazi, Uhariri wa Filamu, Alama ya asili, Ubunifu wa Utengenezaji, Uhariri wa Sauti, Uchanganyiko wa Sauti na Hati ya asili.

source: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
reference: Nyimbo mbili kutoka kwa sinema, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) na Mji wa Nyota, zilipendekezwa kuwa nyimbo bora asilia. Studio ya Lionsgate ilipendekezwa mara 26 – zaidi ya studio nyingine yoyote.
hypothesis: Nyimbo mbili kutoka filamu, Maoni (Wapumbavu ambao Dream) na Jiji la Stars, walipokea uteuzi kwa wimbo bora wa asili. Studio Lionsgate ilipokea uteuzi 26 zaidi ya studio nyingine yoyote.

source: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
reference: Mwishoni mwa Jumapili, Rais wa Marekani Donald Trump, katika taarifa iliyowasilishwa kupitia katibu wa uandishi wa habari, alitangaza kwamba vikosi vya Marekani vitaondoka Siria.
hypothesis: Baadaye Jumapili, Rais wa Marekani Donald Trump, katika taarifa iliyotolewa kupitia waziri wa habari, alitangaza kwamba majeshi ya Marekani yataondoka Syria.

source: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
reference: Tangazo lilifanywa baada ya Trump kuwa na mazungumzo ya simu na Rais wa Uturuki Recep Tayyip Erdogan.
hypothesis: Tangazo hilo lilifanywa baada ya Trump kuzungumza kwa simu na Rais wa Uturuki Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.

source: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
reference: Uturuki ilikua yachukua ulinzi wa wapiganaji wa ISIS waliotekwa ambao, tangazo lilisema kuwa, nchi za Ulaya zilikataa kurudi.
hypothesis: Uturuki pia itachukua ulinzi wa wapiganaji wa ISIS waliokamatwa ambao, taarifa hiyo ilisema, mataifa ya Ulaya yamekataa kuwarudisha.

source: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
reference: Hii haithibitishi tu kuwa baadhi ya dinosaria walikuwa na manyoya, nadharia ambayo tayari imezagaa, bali pia inatoa maelezo ambayo kijumla visukuku haviwezi, kama vile rangi na mpangilio wa pande-tatu.
hypothesis: Hilo halihakikishi tu kwamba angalau dinosaurs fulani walikuwa na manyoya, nadharia ambayo tayari imeenea sana, lakini pia inatoa maelezo ambayo mabaki ya wanyama kwa ujumla hayawezi, kama vile rangi na mpangilio wa ukubwa wa tatu.

source: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
reference: . Wanasayansi wanasema manyoya ya mnyama huyu yalikuwa ya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu upande wa juu na hafifu au rangi ya karotini upande wa chini.
hypothesis: Wanasayansi wanasema kwamba manyoya ya mnyama huyo yalikuwa ya rangi ya chestnut na rangi ya karotenoid.

source: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
reference: Utambuzi huo pia unatoa ufahamu wa mageuko ya manyoya katika ndege.
hypothesis: Pia, utafiti huo unafunua jinsi ambavyo manyoya ya ndege yametokea.

source: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
reference: Kwa sababu manyoya ya dinosau hayana chimbuko uliyostawishwa vizuri, inayoitwa rachi, lakini huwa na sifa zingine za manyoya — barbu na barbule — watafiti waligundua rachi labda ni maendeleo ya baadaye ya uvumbuzi kuliko sifa hizi nyingine.
hypothesis: Kwa sababu majani ya dinosaurs hawana shaft iliyoendelea vizuri, inayoitwa rachis, lakini ina sifa zingine za majani  barbs na barbules  watafiti walihitimisha kuwa rachis ilikuwa labda maendeleo ya baadaye ya mageuzi kuliko sifa hizi nyingine.

source: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
reference: Muundo wa manyoya unaonyesha kwamba hayakutumika katika kupeperuka bali yalitumiwa kudhibiti joto au uonyesho. Watafiti walipendekeza kwamba, ingawa huu ni mkia wa dinosauri mchanga, sampuli inaonyesha manyoya ya utu uzima na si manyoya laini ya ndani ya kifaranga.
hypothesis: Mpangilio wa manyoya hayo unaonyesha kwamba hayakutumiwa kuruka bali kwa ajili ya kudhibiti joto au kuonyesha joto.
